decisions.reason: Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not change the standalone USB regulator, its capacity, activation condition, or source-selection behavior.
The manufacturing handling change does not alter the required AXP2101 battery/USB topology or operating capabilities.
The AXP2101 baking requirement does not change copper-path capacity, current limits, bottleneck avoidance, or stitching-via requirements.
Pre-reflow handling of the AXP2101 does not resolve or change the required rail-monitoring IC, channels, or measurement coverage.
The source attributes damaged samples to omitted pre-reflow baking but does not change the configured DCDC1 voltage or required 3.3V regulation behavior.
The AXP2101 assembly-handling decision does not change the panel button connector, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not alter the GPIO-controlled 5V rail, boost converter, loads, or shutdown behavior.
The source concerns AXP2101 moisture handling during assembly and does not change ESP32 decoupling values or placement.
The pre-reflow baking requirement has no necessary effect on the battery connector series, pitch, pinout, or mounting type.
Although both concern production, the source adds a component-handling step and does not change the required sensor-board fabrication or assembly files.
The source changes manufacturing handling for an already selected AXP2101, not component availability, cost, sourcing, or selection policy.
The AXP2101 baking decision does not change the e-paper backlight circuit, supply options, brightness control, or load requirements.
